intro: A harvested organ taken from the swift-footed plainstriders roaming the arid plains of the Barrens. Though unappetizing to most travelers, it serves as a bizarre yet essential component in exotic Kalimdor brewing traditions.

p: The vast expanses of the Barrens are populated by tall, flightless birds known as plainstriders. While their feathers and meat are often claimed by hunters for tools and simple rations, Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks their internal organs for an entirely different purpose. According to the eccentric brewer, plainstrider kidneys are a necessary ingredient to replicate Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale, imparting a unique kick passed down through an unconventional lineage of brewmasters.
